So the three masses are closed-form in the two defects and their pairing: m1 = 0 if and only if a defect or the pairing vanishes; in the hierarchical limit the middle mass reads the sum of the two defects' terms and the lightest their product over the other two; at the coincident point N = S the masses are exactly geometric (m1 m3 = m2^2); both light masses are first order in the defects. On B1656's sector matter (324 cases) the identities hold to 4e-17 and 2e-16; controls bite (a perturbation breaks J1; A for P A breaks J2; N != S departs from the geometric law). No data. 0 of 19.
